startupEffects: POST https://warriorhq.archiveteam.org/api/register.json when warrior_id is absent; sends runner version and persists returned identity.

POST https://warriorhq.archiveteam.org/api/update.json at startup and every ten minutes; sends warrior_id, lat_lng (null in this source), chosen downloader nickname and selected_project; user-agent includes runner version/type. Server receives network source address.

Processes HQ project metadata and broadcast responses; selected_project=none does not authorize archival downloads/uploads. HQ version responses and seven-day max age can trigger container-local reboot/shutdown behavior. No host privileges/socket granted.
